title: Pairing explainable deep learning classification with clustering to uncover effects of schizophrenia upon whole brain functional network connectivity dynamics
summary: A 1D-CNN classifies rs-fMRI dynamic functional connectivity time series in 160 healthy controls and 151 schizophrenia patients; layer-wise relevance propagation and clustering then identify patterns, with feature-level statistical comparisons. Stratified cross-validation and class comparisons test the analysis; clustering/state features are exploratory, silhouette scores were generally below 0.03, and no symptom-severity associations were significant.
